thread.title: How to select dataframe rows between two datetimes?

author: Ann Kriebel
title: How to select dataframe rows between two datetimes?
text:
I am having trouble selecting rows from a dataframe with a datetime column from a CSV file. I have my code and my sample data. There are no rows returned.
import pandas as pd import numpy as np col_names = ['date','msft','nok','aapl','ibm','amzn'] stockprices = pd.read_csv('./stockdata.csv', skiprows=1, names=col_names) stockprices.loc['2018-01-01 9:00:00':'2018-01-01 11:00:00']
CSV file data:
date msft nok aapl ibm amzn 2018-01-01 08:00:00 107 2 161 140 1295 2018-01-01 09:00:00 112 1 143 130 1298 2018-01-01 10:00:00 109 10 185 137 1647 2018-01-01 11:00:00 98 11 146 105 1331 2018-01-01 12:00:00 83 3 214 131 1355
Basically, trying to select the 3 rows with 9:00:00, 10:00:00 and 11:00:00 times in the dataframe.
Is using the .loc the best way to do this?
Thank you.
